as_told.title: C-van briefing on the gray project inside the black project

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that around 1990 to 1993 his work sat in what he calls a "gray project" hidden inside a "black project", a secret programme, like layers of an onion. He says a Captain White explained it: a black project is placed alongside the gray one, and "only a select few of the people in the black project know about the gray project." Sherman also tells of the briefing itself, where White told him others would explain the rest but "I'm going to talk to you about the gray project"; in that telling he puts the briefing in a communications van at an overseas post, not at NSA headquarters in Maryland.
